page.title: Which kind of mind is yours?
page.sub: Your mind is one slice of a bigger one. Jyotish reads it from the star the Moon was in when you were born.
page.quarter_line: Each star is cut into four quarters, so yours is a slice of a slice. Yours belongs to {sign}, {article} {element} sign.
page.more_h: A few more things shape it
page.light_h: The Moon when you were born
page.company_none: No other graha shares your Moon’s sign. Your mind keeps its own company.
page.share_ask: Which kind of mind is yours?
page.ask_prompt: What does my Moon in {star} say about how I think, and what should I use it for?
how: In a birth chart the Moon stands for the mind.
The Moon circles the sky in about 27 days and spends about a day in each star.
The stars come in seven kinds
An old text sorts them by nature: steady, moving, light, soft, fierce, sharp, and soft and sharp at once.
page.no_time: Add your birth time to see your quarter.
page.two_stars: The Moon changed star that day. Pick the part of the day you were born in.
sources: The Moon as the mind: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 3.12. The great Person whose mind became the Moon: Rig Veda 10.90.13.
The seven natures of the stars: Brihat Samhita, chapter 98. The text sorts the stars to choose a day for a task.
Movable, fixed and dual signs: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 4.5.
Reading all of this as a kind of mind is Sutram’s reading. It is for reflection and is no substitute for medical or psychological advice.

kinds.name: The steady mind
kinds.like: Your mind settles on a thing and stays with it. It can sit with one book for hours, it likes to finish what it starts, and it gets better with time.
kinds.texts: The texts pick these stars for crowning a king, planting trees, building a town, sowing seed, and anything meant to last.
good: Building a home or a team
grain: Give it time. A steady mind hates being rushed
Let it finish one thing before the next
Ask it for the long view
kinds.watch: It can hold on after it is time to let go

kinds.name: The moving mind
kinds.like: Your mind works best in motion. It searches, plans and brainstorms on its feet, and a walk often solves what sitting still could not.
kinds.texts: The texts pick these stars for travel and for any work that has to move.
grain: Walk while you think
Change the room when you are stuck
Keep one fixed habit as an anchor
kinds.watch: It can leave before the work is done

kinds.name: The light mind
kinds.like: Your mind is quick and light on its feet. It picks up a skill fast and likes work it can finish in one sitting.
kinds.texts: The texts pick these stars for trade, learning, craft, the arts and medicine.
good: Short tasks with a clear finish
grain: Give it short tasks with a clear finish
Let it learn by doing
Pair it with someone who finishes
kinds.watch: It can move on when the spark goes

kinds.name: The soft mind
kinds.like: Your mind is gentle and reads a room well. It looks for what is pleasant and for what brings people together.
kinds.texts: The texts pick these stars for friendship and love, music, new clothes, ornaments and celebrations.
grain: Give it good company and a pleasant room
Bring hard news gently
Let it make things beautiful
kinds.watch: It can put off a hard talk for too long

kinds.name: The fierce mind
kinds.like: Your mind runs hot and does not back down. Pressure wakes it up, and it can do the hard thing that others put off.
kinds.texts: The texts give these stars the fiercest work, such as battle, fire, and tearing down what must go.
grain: Give it a real challenge
Be direct. It respects that
Let it cool down before a big talk
kinds.watch: It can come on too strong

kinds.name: The sharp mind
kinds.like: Your mind goes straight to what is underneath. It notices what others miss and does not accept the easy answer.
kinds.texts: The texts give these stars the cutting work, such as strict discipline, mantra practice, and breaking a tie or binding one.
good: Editing and cutting what is not needed
Deep practice, such as mantra or meditation
grain: Give it the real reason
Hand it the hard problem
Let it work alone when it needs to
kinds.watch: Its words can cut deeper than it means

kinds.name: The soft-and-sharp mind
kinds.like: Your mind has two hands. One is gentle and one cuts, and you choose which a moment needs. People meet your kindness first and your edge later.
kinds.texts: The texts call these two stars soft and sharp at once and say their results are mixed. Both belong to Agni, the fire.
good: Cooking and any work with fire
Jobs that need care and a firm line
grain: Tell it which hand you need today
Give it work that needs both care and a cut
Expect warmth first and the edge after
kinds.watch: People cannot always tell which hand is coming

stars.name: Ashwini
stars.reading: A mind that is first out of the gate. It moves before others have decided, and it likes to fix things fast.
stars.deity: the Ashwini Kumaras, the twin healers

stars.name: Bharani
stars.reading: A mind that can carry what is heavy. It sees a hard thing through to the end.

stars.name: Krittika
stars.reading: A mind like a kitchen fire. It warms and feeds, and it burns away what is false.

stars.name: Rohini
stars.reading: A mind that grows things. It is patient and fond of beauty, and it makes a place feel like home.

stars.name: Mrigashira
stars.reading: A mind that searches. Curious and gentle, it follows a scent from one thing to the next.

stars.name: Ardra
stars.reading: Moist, like the ground after rain. A mind that feels the storm fully, then starts fresh.

stars.name: Punarvasu
stars.reading: A mind that comes back. It can lose its way and find it again, and it returns from every trip with something good.
stars.deity: Aditi, the mother of the gods

stars.name: Pushya
stars.reading: A mind that feeds others. It teaches, looks after people, and does small useful things every day.
stars.deity: Brihaspati, the teacher of the gods

stars.name: Ashlesha
stars.reading: A mind that coils around a thing and holds it. Watchful and hard to fool, it sees what is hidden.

stars.name: Magha
stars.reading: A mind that remembers where it comes from. It carries itself with pride and wants to be worthy of its people.

stars.name: Purva Phalguni
stars.reading: A mind that loves life. It wants play, pleasure and good company, and it goes after them with full heat.
stars.symbol: the front legs of a bed

stars.name: Uttara Phalguni
stars.reading: A mind that keeps its word. It is the friend who stays, and it likes a clear agreement.
stars.symbol: the back legs of a bed

stars.name: Hasta
stars.reading: A mind in the hands. It learns by making, and it is clever, quick and good with detail.

stars.name: Chitra
stars.reading: A mind with an eye for design. It sees how a thing could look and wants to make it beautiful.

stars.name: Swati
stars.reading: A mind like a young shoot in the wind. It bends and does not break, and it needs room to move on its own.
stars.symbol: a young sprout bending in the wind

stars.name: Vishakha
stars.reading: A mind with one goal and two roads to it. It is patient until the goal is close, then it pushes hard.
stars.symbol: a triumphal arch, a potter's wheel

stars.name: Anuradha
stars.reading: A mind made for friendship. It is loyal, works well with others, and blooms in hard places like a lotus.

stars.name: Jyeshtha
stars.reading: A mind that takes charge. It feels responsible for others and guards what is its own.
stars.deity: Indra, the king of the gods

stars.name: Mula
stars.reading: A mind that digs. It keeps asking why until it reaches the bottom of a thing.
stars.symbol: a bunch of roots tied together

stars.name: Purva Ashadha
stars.reading: A mind that does not accept defeat. It believes it can win, and that belief carries other people along.

stars.name: Uttara Ashadha
stars.reading: A mind that wins slowly and for good. It takes the long road and does things the right way.

stars.name: Shravana
stars.reading: A mind that listens. It learns by hearing, remembers what was said, and travels to learn more.

stars.name: Dhanishta
stars.reading: A mind with rhythm. It keeps time, moves well with a group, and likes to be seen doing it.

stars.name: Shatabhisha
stars.reading: A mind that keeps to itself and thinks in systems. It wants to find what truly fixes a thing.
stars.symbol: an empty circle, a hundred healers
stars.deity: Varuna, the god of the cosmic waters

stars.name: Purva Bhadrapada
stars.means: the first of the blessed feet
stars.reading: A mind of strong conviction. It can burn for an idea and give up comfort for it.
stars.symbol: the front of a funeral cot

stars.name: Uttara Bhadrapada
stars.means: the second of the blessed feet
stars.reading: A mind with depth. Calm on the surface and slow to anger, it holds steady when things get rough.
stars.symbol: the back of a funeral cot
stars.deity: Ahir Budhnya, the serpent of the deep

stars.name: Revati
stars.reading: A mind that looks after others on the road. Kind and dreamy, it helps people get where they are going.

element.fire: A fire sign. Your mind runs on belief and energy.
element.earth: An earth sign. Your mind runs on what is real and useful.
element.air: An air sign. Your mind runs on ideas and people.
element.water: A water sign. Your mind runs on feeling.

sign_type.movable: It is a movable sign, so your mind likes to be on the move and to start things.
sign_type.fixed: It is a fixed sign, so your mind likes to stay put and hold its ground.
sign_type.dual: It is a dual sign, so your mind likes to keep two roads open.

quarter.fire: It adds drive. You act on what you think.
quarter.earth: It adds patience. You want your thinking to be useful.
quarter.air: It adds talk. You think by sharing ideas.
quarter.water: It adds feeling. Your heart weighs in first.

light.label: Near the new Moon
light.line: A dark Moon keeps its light inside. Your mind does its best work in private.

light.label: A growing Moon
light.line: The Moon was filling. Your mind reaches outward and builds as it goes.

light.label: Near the full Moon
light.line: A full Moon shows everything. Your feelings are easy to read, for you and for others.

light.label: A waning Moon
light.line: The Moon was emptying. Your mind sorts, lets go, and knows what to keep.

Sun.line: Your mind stays close to your purpose and wants its work to matter.

Mars.line: Your mind is quick to act and likes a challenge.

Mercury.line: Your mind thinks in words and works things out by talking or writing.

Jupiter.line: Your mind looks for the lesson and the bigger picture.

Venus.line: Your mind is drawn to beauty, comfort and people.

Saturn.line: Your mind checks things twice and takes its duties seriously.

Rahu.line: Your mind is hungry for the new and makes big whatever it looks at.

Ketu.line: Your mind lets go easily and needs time alone.
